method: Each listed render of the af615c841 board opened and inspected individually (rendered by cad/render_previews.py at that commit). Supplements, does not replace, the native ERC/DRC/parity and the independent pin audit.
not_reviewed_this_pass: schematic pages (unchanged review basis: native ERC and parity)

observations.gerber-ground.png: In1.Cu is one GND pour. Voids only at the intended op-amp input relief (U5 block, U6, the L-shaped U7/TIA region); BNC centre pins and signal vias cleared; four NPTH mounting holes.
observations.gerber-inner-routing.png: In2.Cu carries HPOT from J7 east then south to U6 (about 45 mm; in the reve_bnc extraction at 8.9 pF), LPOT after its F.Cu start, relay-coil runs to K1-K3, and rails. Sparse; no unexplained long runs.
observations.gerber-bottom-copper.png: HCUR on B.Cu along the back of the jacks and down the east edge to the range relays, as documented. The RP2040 relay-drive bundle runs on B.Cu to Q2-Q6 (static during captures: latching relays). No B.Cu components; THT pads for J2, J4-J6 and BNCs only.
observations.pcb-front.png: F.Cu and silk: BNC labels HCUR/HPOT/LPOT/LCUR match design.json (J3/J7/J8/J9); K1-K4 labelled with ranges; U14 decoupling clustered; switcher (U13, L1/L2, D2/D3) bottom-left, about 65 mm from the codec.
observations.gerber-top-mask.png: Openings for all SMT pads, exposed pads, BNC and header THT; mounting holes cleared.
observations.gerber-bottom-mask.png: Bottom openings only for THT pads, USB shell anchors, DC jack and mounting holes: vias tented.
observations.gerber-top-paste.png: Exposed pads windowpaned (U1 2x2, U14 2x2, U13 3x3, U11/U12 split); no paste on THT.
observations.assembly-top.png: Designators placed and legible at review zoom. Fab-layer reference text overlaps on D5-D8 next to their bodies (cosmetic, Fab layer only, not fabricated).
observations.gerber-top-copper.png: F.Cu matches pcb-front.png: codec input network (four identical legs) between U14 and U6/U7; LPOT and LCUR leave J8/J9 on F.Cu toward K4 and R105/R106; switcher loop compact around U13.
